method.estimating_equation: For each focal channel, average m1(X)-m0(X) + A*(Y-m1(X))/e(X) - (1-A)*(Y-m0(X))/(1-e(X)), using the preregistered clipped propensity only for numerical stabilization.
method.outcome_nuisance_model: Interpretable L2-regularized logistic regression of conversion on focal treatment plus declared observable adjustment variables.
method.propensity_nuisance_model: Interpretable L2-regularized logistic regression of focal treatment on the declared observable adjustment variables.
method.rationale: AIPW directly targets the preregistered average probability-difference estimand and combines outcome and treatment models without requiring a flexible black-box learner. Its failure remains diagnostically interpretable.
method.double_robustness_limit: The double-robustness property is conditional on causal identification assumptions. It does not repair unobserved confounding or positivity failure.

adjustment: binary indicators for each non-focal observed channel
normalized earliest observable touch position in the horizon
normalized latest observable touch position in the horizon

nuisance_hyperparameter_development.selection_rule: Use DEVELOPMENT worlds only. Among numerically valid combinations, choose the pair with lowest unweighted mean channel-effect MAE across the preregistered development worlds. If tied within 1e-6, choose the pair with the larger sum of L2 penalties. Candidate 1 holdout information and frozen Phase 1 results are prohibited.

uncertainty.method: 90% normal interval from the empirical standard error of the AIPW influence/pseudo-outcome values
uncertainty.nuisance_uncertainty_note: This finite-sample interval treats fitted nuisance functions as estimated inputs; undercoverage is a preregistered possible failure and is externally evaluated.

development_worlds.purpose: selection correlated with observable co-exposure/history proxies
known-zero focal effect under selected exposure

primary_observed_selection_comparison.rule: Candidate 2 aggregate absolute known-zero error across the same frozen seeds must be strictly lower than frozen Candidate 1 on the same Phase 1 cases, and Candidate 2 must improve at least 3 of the 4 scenario-level mean errors.
primary_observed_selection_comparison.comparator_source: Candidate 1 FROZEN_PHASE1 historical results only; Candidate 1 sealed holdout is prohibited.

known_zero_absolute_error.justification: Six percentage points on the probability-effect scale is an ex-ante absolute calibration tolerance, not derived from Candidate 1 holdout results.

sealed_holdout_falsification.threshold_justification: The effect-error tolerance is a single ex-ante nine-percentage-point probability-scale bound across all holdout families rather than family-specific tuning. Requiring at least 7 of 8 channel truths inside nominal 90% intervals corresponds to 0.875 family coverage. Overlap limits are preregistered diagnostics against reliance on extreme inverse weights. None use Candidate 1 holdout-v1 values.

freeze_rule: After development hyperparameters are selected, freeze code, nuisance definitions, hyperparameters, clipping policy, uncertainty, declaration and criteria before FROZEN_PHASE1. No tuning after frozen Phase 1.
holdout_rule: Only a frozen candidate that passes every preregistered pre-holdout gate may consume exactly one feedback-bearing candidate2-holdout-v1 exposure.
